# Drawer: `jl-drawer`

A panel that slides over the page from an edge, for a task beside the page rather than in place of it.

- Class `JlDrawer`, a organism: `import { JlDrawer } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/drawer

A drawer keeps the page in view while a task happens beside it: editing a record, filters, settings,
a navigation menu on a phone. It is a modal on the browser's own dialog element: the page behind is inert, focus
stays inside, Escape and a click on the backdrop close it (unless persistent).

It slides from the right by default, from the left for navigation, or from the bottom as a sheet, with rounded top
corners and a handle, which suits phones. The content scrolls between a fixed header and footer: the heading and
the actions slot at the top, the footer slot for the buttons at the bottom. People who ask for less motion see it
appear without sliding.

## Use

```ts
import { JlButton, JlDrawer } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlDrawer
  description="Narrow the list of projects."
  heading="Filters"
  placement="right"
>
  <p>The content of the drawer.</p>
  <JlButton slot="footer" label="Reset" />
  <JlButton slot="footer" variant="primary" label="Apply" />
</JlDrawer>
```

```html
<jl-drawer
  description="Narrow the list of projects."
  heading="Filters"
  placement="right"
>
  <p>The content of the drawer.</p>
  <jl-button slot="footer" label="Reset"></jl-button>
  <jl-button slot="footer" variant="primary" label="Apply"></jl-button>
</jl-drawer>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `heading` (attribute `heading`): `string`, default `''`. The title.
- `description` (attribute `description`): `string`, default `''`. A sentence under the title.
- `placement` (attribute `placement`): `'right' | 'left' | 'bottom'`, default `'right'`. The edge it slides from.
- `size` (attribute `size`): `'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`, default `'md'`. The width: 320, 420 or 640 pixels; from the bottom, at most 40%, 60% or 88% of the height.
- `open` (attribute `open`): `boolean`, default `false`. Whether it is open.
- `persistent` (attribute `persistent`): `boolean`, default `false`. Escape and the backdrop do not close it, and it has no close button.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `open` (`onOpen` in JSX), detail `undefined`: The drawer opened.
- `close` (`onClose` in JSX), detail `undefined`: The drawer closed: a button, Escape, the backdrop or close().

## Slots

- The default slot: The content; it scrolls between the header and the footer.
- `actions`: Buttons in the header, before the close button.
- `footer`: The buttons at the bottom, on the right.

## Methods

- `show(): void`: Opens the drawer.
- `close(): void`: Closes the drawer.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The native dialog element.
- `--size` (custom property): The width (the maximum height from the bottom), set by size.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### A form in a drawer

A small form, its buttons in the footer and a quiet action in the header.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-button class="open-profile" variant="primary" icon="pencil" label="Edit profile"></jl-button>
</div>
<jl-drawer class="profile" heading="Edit profile" description="Changes show on your public page.">
  <div class="stack">
    <jl-field label="Full name" required>
      <jl-input value="Ada Lovelace" required></jl-input>
    </jl-field>
    <jl-field label="Email" hint="Only members of your workspace see it.">
      <jl-input type="email" value="ada@example.com" icon="mail"></jl-input>
    </jl-field>
    <jl-field label="Website">
      <jl-input type="url" placeholder="https://" icon="globe"></jl-input>
    </jl-field>
  </div>
  <jl-button slot="actions" variant="ghost" icon="external-link" hint="View public page" size="sm"></jl-button>
  <jl-button slot="footer" label="Cancel"></jl-button>
  <jl-button slot="footer" variant="primary" label="Save changes"></jl-button>
</jl-drawer>
```

```js
const drawer = root.querySelector('jl-drawer.profile');
root.querySelector('.open-profile').events.register('press', () => drawer.show());
for (const button of drawer.querySelectorAll('jl-button[slot="footer"]')) {
  button.events.register('press', () => drawer.close());
}
```

### From the left

From the left, narrow: a navigation menu.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-button class="open-menu" icon="menu" label="Menu"></jl-button>
</div>
<jl-drawer class="menu" placement="left" size="sm" heading="Acme workspace">
  <div class="stack">
    <jl-button variant="ghost" icon="house" label="Home"></jl-button>
    <jl-button variant="ghost" icon="inbox" label="Inbox"></jl-button>
    <jl-button variant="ghost" icon="users" label="Team"></jl-button>
    <jl-button variant="ghost" icon="settings" label="Settings"></jl-button>
  </div>
</jl-drawer>
```

### Bottom sheet

From the bottom, as a sheet: rounded top corners and a handle.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-button class="open-share" icon="share" label="Share"></jl-button>
</div>
<jl-drawer class="share" placement="bottom" size="sm" heading="Share board" description="Anyone with the link can view it.">
  <div class="stack">
    <jl-input value="https://acme.app/b/q3-roadmap" readonly icon="link"></jl-input>
    <div class="row">
      <jl-button icon="copy" label="Copy link"></jl-button>
      <jl-button icon="mail" label="Email"></jl-button>
    </div>
  </div>
</jl-drawer>
```

### Persistent

Persistent and large: Escape and the backdrop do nothing; only its own buttons close it.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-button class="open-review" label="Review the import"></jl-button>
</div>
<jl-drawer class="review" size="lg" heading="Import 128 contacts" persistent>
  <p>Check the columns before importing: the first row of the file is used as headings.</p>
  <jl-button slot="footer" label="Back"></jl-button>
  <jl-button slot="footer" variant="primary" label="Import"></jl-button>
</jl-drawer>
```
